description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity named MainActivity that demonstrates the use of TextSwitcher with animations. It sets up a TextSwitcher with fade in/out animations, a button to increment a counter, and dynamically updates the displayed text with smooth animations.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating usage of TextSwitcher with animated text updates and a button to increment a counter.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the TextSwitcher with factory and animations, and configures the button to update the text.

methods.name: mFactory.makeView
methods.description: Creates and returns a new TextView configured for use in the TextSwitcher.
